answer: Ring a surprise bell. At a random minute each epoch, the beacon sends every identity a short fresh prompt to answer within 90 seconds. An independent agent has its own model and queue, so its delay stays flat. A farm pushing hundreds of heads through one GPU or one API quota hits a summit of load, and its replies trail out like a comet tail, the last-served heads latest. Keys whose delays stack in that shape share one reward. To hide, a farm must buy real parallel capacity for every head, and cheap keys lose their velvet cover.
